description:
Add an RFC 5280-baseline TLS-client-authentication profile to pkix-profiles, paired with verify_tls_client_dns / verify_tls_client_mailbox (shipped under PKIX-fmtv.11.2 in pkix-chain 0.4.x).

## Why

verify_tls_client_dns and verify_tls_client_mailbox are generic over <P: Profile>; production callers need a profile that:

- Sets required_leaf_eku = Some(vec![ID_KP_CLIENT_AUTH])
- Does NOT set require_subject_alt_name (client-auth flows commonly read identity from Subject DN, which is fine — the wrapper's Option<&ServerName>/None mode covers that case)
- Otherwise tracks BasicTlsProfile's shape

## Sibling pattern

BasicTlsProfile -> BasicTlsClientProfile is the exact RFC-5280-EKU sibling of BasicCodeSigningProfile, mirroring the symmetric server/client split common in TLS code.

## Deliverable

In pkix-profiles:

```rust
pub struct BasicTlsClientProfile;
impl Profile for BasicTlsClientProfile {
    fn id(&self) -> &'static str { "ietf.tls-client-basic" }
    fn version(&self) -> &'static str { "RFC 5280 §4.2.1.12" }
    fn policy(&self, now_unix: u64) -> ValidationPolicy {
        let mut p = ValidationPolicy::new(now_unix);
        p.required_leaf_eku = Some(vec![ID_KP_CLIENT_AUTH]);
        p
    }
    fn policy_oids(&self) -> &[ObjectIdentifier] { &[] }
}

pub fn basic_tls_client_policy(now_unix: u64) -> ValidationPolicy {
    BasicTlsClientProfile.policy(now_unix)
}
```

ID_KP_CLIENT_AUTH = ObjectIdentifier("1.3.6.1.5.5.7.3.2") (RFC 5280 §4.2.1.12).

## Tests

In pkix-profiles unit tests:
- BasicTlsClientProfile.id() / version() pinned
- policy(NOW).required_leaf_eku contains exactly ID_KP_CLIENT_AUTH
- policy.require_subject_alt_name is FALSE (different from BasicTlsProfile; client-auth flows commonly use DN identity)

In pkix-chain tests/verify_tls_client.rs:
- One smoke test under BasicTlsClientProfile using the leaf-clientauth-dns.der fixture (which has EKU=clientAuth) — proves the profile wiring works end-to-end

## CHANGELOG

pkix-profiles: minor bump (additive)
pkix-chain: note in next CHANGELOG entry that verify_tls_client_* can now be paired with BasicTlsClientProfile out-of-the-box.

## Out of scope

- CA/B Forum equivalent (pkix-profiles-cabf::TlsClientProfile if one exists) — separate bead if needed.
- WebPkiClientProfile — webpki has historically been server-cert-focused; whether to ship a client equivalent is a separate question.

## Context

Filed by the do-beads loop when shipping PKIX-fmtv.11.2 client half (verify_tls_client_dns + verify_tls_client_mailbox, 2026-05-12). The wrappers shipped without this profile because (a) they are generic over Profile (the caller decides), and (b) shipping a new pkix-profiles public type is a separate non-coupled API addition that deserved its own bead. Without this profile, callers either roll their own ValidationPolicy or use Rfc5280Profile (which doesn't enforce id-kp-clientAuth).
title: BasicTlsClientProfile + basic_tls_client_policy for verify_tls_client_* production use
